\section[(dialogue)]{Words from chapters 260-263 — a first pass}

\label{lesson:MR-R268-first-pass-words-from-chapters-260-263}



\begin{quote}
Say the words for a sitar and a ball.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{Your turn}
Say these aloud:

\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item generous, talkative, worried, unmarried, married
  \item ugly, tired, hungry, thirsty, short-tempered
  \item temperature, a fly, society, the government, a law
  \item a singer, a programme, an actor, an actress, a poem
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
Generous? (\textbf{\mr{उदार}}, \emph{udār}.) Talkative? (\textbf{\mr{बोलका} / \mr{बोलकी}}, \emph{bolkā / bolkī}.) Worried? (\textbf{\mr{चिंताग्रस्त}}, \emph{cintāgrasta}.) Unmarried? (\textbf{\mr{अविवाहित}}, \emph{avivāhit}.) Married? (\textbf{\mr{विवाहित}}, \emph{vivāhit}.) Ugly? (\textbf{\mr{कुरूप}}, \emph{kurūp}.) Tired? (\textbf{\mr{थकलेला}}, \emph{thaklelā}.) Hungry? (\textbf{\mr{भुकेला}}, \emph{bhukelā}.) Thirsty? (\textbf{\mr{तहानलेला}}, \emph{tahānlelā}.) Short-tempered? (\textbf{\mr{रागीट}}, \emph{rāgīṭ}.) Temperature? (\textbf{\mr{तापमान}}, \emph{tāpmān}.) A fly? (\textbf{\mr{माशी}}, \emph{māśī}.) Society? (\textbf{\mr{समाज}}, \emph{samāj}.) The government? (\textbf{\mr{सरकार}}, \emph{sarkār}.) A law? (\textbf{\mr{कायदा}}, \emph{kāydā}.) A singer? (\textbf{\mr{गायक} / \mr{गायिका}}, \emph{gāyak / gāyikā}.) A programme? (\textbf{\mr{कार्यक्रम}}, \emph{kāryakram}.) An actor? (\textbf{\mr{अभिनेता}}, \emph{abhinetā}.) An actress? (\textbf{\mr{अभिनेत्री}}, \emph{abhinetrī}.) A poem? (\textbf{\mr{कविता}}, \emph{kavitā}.)
\end{tcolorbox}
\section[(dialogue)]{Words from chapters 264-268 — a second pass}

\label{lesson:MR-R268-second-pass-words-from-chapters-264-268}



\begin{quote}
Say the words for an elderly person and twins.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{Your turn}
Say these aloud:

\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item an elderly person, twins, a mother-in-law, a father-in-law, a son-in-law
  \item permission, a ban, safety, advice, a promise
  \item an engine, a highway, a fine, a licence, a helmet
  \item a volcano, a plateau, a pebble, mud, dust
  \item a tool, a tabla, a flute, a sitar, a ball
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
An elderly person? (\textbf{\mr{वृद्ध}}, \emph{vṛddha}.) Twins? (\textbf{\mr{जुळे}}, \emph{juḷe}.) A mother-in-law? (\textbf{\mr{सासू}}, \emph{sāsū}.) A father-in-law? (\textbf{\mr{सासरे}}, \emph{sāsre}.) A son-in-law? (\textbf{\mr{जावई}}, \emph{jāvaī}.) Permission? (\textbf{\mr{परवानगी}}, \emph{parvāngī}.) A ban? (\textbf{\mr{बंदी}}, \emph{bandī}.) Safety? (\textbf{\mr{सुरक्षा}}, \emph{surakṣā}.) Advice? (\textbf{\mr{सल्ला}}, \emph{sallā}.) A promise? (\textbf{\mr{वचन}}, \emph{vacan}.) An engine? (\textbf{\mr{इंजिन}}, \emph{iñjin}.) A highway? (\textbf{\mr{महामार्ग}}, \emph{mahāmārg}.) A fine? (\textbf{\mr{दंड}}, \emph{daṇḍ}.) A licence? (\textbf{\mr{परवाना}}, \emph{parvānā}.) A helmet? (\textbf{\mr{शिरस्त्राण}}, \emph{śirastrāṇ}.) A volcano? (\textbf{\mr{ज्वालामुखी}}, \emph{jvālāmukhī}.) A plateau? (\textbf{\mr{पठार}}, \emph{paṭhār}.) A pebble? (\textbf{\mr{गोटा}}, \emph{goṭā}.) Mud? (\textbf{\mr{चिखल}}, \emph{cikhal}.) Dust? (\textbf{\mr{धूळ}}, \emph{dhūḷ}.) A tool? (\textbf{\mr{अवजार}}, \emph{avjār}.) A tabla? (\textbf{\mr{तबला}}, \emph{tablā}.) A flute? (\textbf{\mr{बासरी}}, \emph{bāsrī}.) A sitar? (\textbf{\mr{सतार}}, \emph{satār}.) A ball? (\textbf{\mr{चेंडू}}, \emph{ceṇḍū}.)
\end{tcolorbox}
